text.en:
Netherlands to Turkey Shipping — Hanbros UK

Netherlands to Turkey shipping through Hanbros UK: reliable groupage, express parcels and removals for Dutch residents sending goods home.

Our operations span Amsterdam, Rotterdam, The Hague, Utrecht and nationwide. Dutch customers benefit from our transparent pricing, bilingual support and full customs brokerage on both sides.

Services from Netherlands to Turkey

  • International cargo & parcels to all Turkish cities.
  • Household removals with professional packing and customs.
  • Vehicle shipping with full export/import documentation.
  • Commercial freight for businesses and traders.
  • Express & economy options to match your budget and timeline.

Hanbros UK advantage: Whether your goods originate in Netherlands or the UK, you receive one dedicated coordinator, one transparent quote and one trusted brand on the Europe–Turkey corridor.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do you collect in Netherlands?

Yes — we arrange collections across Amsterdam, Rotterdam, The Hague, Utrecht and nationwide and coordinate transit to Turkey via our UK hub and direct routes.

How long does shipping from Netherlands to Turkey take?

Typically 7–21 days depending on service level, route and customs — we confirm at quote stage.

Is customs included?

Export and import customs brokerage is handled by our experienced team on both sides.

Hanbros UK — your partner for Netherlands to Turkey logistics.
